subject: Working with designers and trade partners
hook: Your drawing goes in. Labelled parts come out.
ig:
Your drawing goes in. Labelled parts come out.

This is how we work with designers, fitters and small makers who need the machining done but want to keep the design and the client relationship.

Your drawing or cutting list is checked part by part. Boards are cut on our sliding table panel saw, edges applied on the edge bander to your spec, and hinge cups, shelf-pin rows and dowel holes drilled on the multi-spindle boring machine.

Every part is labelled to match your list, so assembly on your bench or on site is straightforward. If you'd rather not assemble, we can build the carcasses too.

You collect from our Hanley workshop, or we arrange delivery.

Comment TRADE and we'll send you the link to our trade services page.
fb:
Thirty seconds of what our trade workshop does for designers and fitters.

You send the drawing or cutting list. We check it, cut the boards on our panel saw, edge them on the edge bander, drill hinge cups and shelf-pin rows on the boring machine, and label every part to match your list. Assembly is available too if you'd rather the carcasses arrive built.

Collection from our Hanley workshop or delivery quoted per job. If you're a designer, fitter or maker around Stoke-on-Trent, have a look at our trade services:
https://superiofurniture.com/trade-services/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=whole-home-bespoke-solutions&utm_content=day-324
cta: Comment TRADE for the trade services link
